title: Qwen3.6-27B sole-T16 Q4 dual-WMMA SiLU prefill

change.dataflow: One 128-thread/four-wave block decodes independent gate/up sole-T16 slabs, loads each BF16 activation K16 fragment once per wave, applies both FP16-WMMA projections, rounds both projection results to BF16 in LDS, and applies SiLU at the same BF16 operation boundary before one global output write.
change.fallback: The existing unfused pair remains registered and owns rows below 512, unsupported shapes/layouts, registry misses, decode, and verifier/MTP small rows.

actual_weight_leaf.hardware: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX, gfx1100, HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1
actual_weight_leaf.protocol: Three warmups, nine counterbalanced HIP-event samples per shape, retained two shared-B projections plus separate BF16 SiLU versus candidate dual projection plus SiLU.

counterbalanced_full_prefill_ab.protocol: One resident model/session per board/shape, warm baseline and candidate, seven alternating pairs; baseline disables only the new linear_pair_silu owner.

independent_production_matrix.protocol: One discarded warmup plus three measured persistent-session resets, repeated-token prompt, 128 graph-replay decode transitions, BF16 KV, cached HIP builds.

decode_and_mtp_scope.decode_dispatch: unchanged because the candidate requires rows >= 512
decode_and_mtp_scope.production_decode: Both boards complete 512/1K/4K graph-decode matrices with finite exact repeated-token IDs; XTX medians remain 33.513/34.539/31.413 tok/s and W7900 28.318/28.873/26.186 tok/s.
decode_and_mtp_scope.llama_compatible_mtp: A separate full ten-prompt serial-exact B1-B3 diagnostic completes with all greedy outputs and GPU/CPU acceptance exact and tracked close zero. Its speed rows are not promoted because serial-exact is diagnostic rather than the retained native verifier protocol.

cross_engine_status.decision: This materially reopens and reduces the prefill blocker but does not close llama.cpp HIP parity or the campaign's 1% margin. Re-profile the retained path before selecting another optimization.

validation.focused_tests: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 ... python -m pytest -q tests/test_gguf_linear_dispatch.py tests/test_gguf_q4_k_t16_dense.py -> 96 passed
validation.leaf_exactness: Rows 512/1K/4K actual-weight output is BF16-bit exact to two retained projections plus separate SiLU; focused HIP fixture additionally covers the non-tile-aligned row tail M513.
validation.lint: ruff, git diff --check, and worklog schema pass

decision: Retain as the gfx1100 model/shape/row-scoped default. It is operation-complete, sole-resident, byte-neutral, exact at the unfused BF16 boundary, uniformly faster on both gfx1100 boards, and leaves registered unfused fallbacks plus decode/MTP small-row owners unchanged.
